operads/infrastructure/anti_skill_catalo: Full body reviewed. operads/infrastructure/autopoiesis/file_: Full body reviewed. SHA256-addressed objects use fsynced temporary bytes and atomic no-clobber hard links; existing bytes must match. Reads recheck digest and archive fallback only accepts LF/CRLF normalization when the resulting digest exactly matches the requested digest. Snapshot reconstitution checks sequence digest, ID and count, not all metadata. Directory durability, hostile-writer races, archive resource bounds and all ancestor links are not established. No vault or source deletion executed.
operads/infrastructure/autopoiesis/harve: Full body reviewed. Sorted regular-file inventory rejects descendant links/reparse points; clear_verified requires a matching whole inventory and rehashes each file before unlink, preserves root .gitkeep and removes empty directories. This is cooperative byte custody, not atomic deletion: late failures can leave partial progress and a check/use race remains. Root resolution assumes a trusted root. No clearing executed.
operads/infrastructure/autopoiesis/json_: Full body reviewed. Candidate JSON persistence does not activate antibodies. Malformed/unreadable catalog silently becomes an empty catalog, so a later merge can replace prior inventory. Repeated antibody ID increments the existing catalog entry while overwriting the individual object with the new antibody, without payload equality, potentially making representations disagree. IDs are trusted as filename material and writes are not atomic. No production writes executed.
operads/infrastructure/autopoiesis/intak: Full body reviewed. Explicit input paths are checked for regular nonempty files and ancestor links before content-addressed custody. UTF8 and JSON parsing follow storage; normal JSON loading does not reject duplicate keys. Recursion markers classify origin/outcome rather than establish learning. Signal extraction invokes a RustSymbolGameHost native method, so the Python marshaling code does not establish signal correctness. Native execution was not performed.
operads/infrastructure/autopoiesis/agent: Full body reviewed in complete bounded ranges. Parent calls retain the same budget/executor/model policy and require nonempty checked task-turn replies; a fresh review turn is not independent scientific evidence. Artifact readers bind normalized text against an optional deployed Git ref, with a second-read race. Agent licensing/frontmatter and workflow seats produce local declarations, not operadic-law proofs; sequential seat results aggregate REFUSE/HOLD/PASS and use a zero progress measure. Artifact evaluation compares exact expected outputs. CommandEvaluationSuite executes caller-supplied commands with inherited environment and a 60-second timeout, not a network or host-effects sandbox; no such commands/providers were invoked.
operads/infrastructure/autopoiesis/git_l: Full body reviewed in two complete ranges. Catalog and isolated worktree preparation pin origin/main and allowed artifact paths; candidate commits run mirror/budget checks and stage a registry recording normalized artifact hashes. Verification checks HEAD and tracked cleanliness, omitting untracked-file changes. GitHub publication validates origin, current parent base, lesson ownership markers and remote branch heads, then uses force-with-lease and recovers push/PR interruption. The publication receipt is scoped replay evidence supplied by upstream validation, not independently verified within publish. Path checking is exact-case and command runner has no timeout; catalog strips displayed blob whitespace. No Git fetch/worktree/commit/push/PR command was run during review.
